description:
Faggin Field Bridge is a SYNTHETIC, measured mapping of Federico Faggin's quantum-field theory of consciousness (Quantum Information Panpsychism, with Giacomo Mauro D'Ariano, arXiv:2012.06580; book-length statement Irreducible, 2024) onto the sparkainlp-x work, in Python (3.11–3.13). Faggin is the theory author; Jean-François Brisson is the bridge/test author. Faggin has not reviewed or endorsed this software.

The bridge's central quantity is attunement, A = U × (1 + δ) − C, where U is the spooky correlation (unity, mean pairwise |dot| over 5 noisy copies), C is the normalized entropy cost, and δ is one clipped calibrator scalar in [−0.05, 0.05] (the membrane-arena Yin bound). The package reproduces the source numbers fresh from their definitions: de Broglie spooky 0.99999995 at σ = 0.01, calibration improvement exactly log10(1/0.95) = 0.022276 orders, tensor-membrane mean single-qubit entropy 0.955 bits. The Omega-Genesis spooky 0.9005 is the notebook's reported value; the synthetic reproduction gives 0.837 (same regime, not exact) because the original evolved state is unavailable, and the difference is reported, not hidden. Empathy 0.5503 is the notebook's reported value, recorded as a supplied proxy, not recomputed.

Version 0.2.0 adds three quantum-thought modules: concurrence of a two-thought Bell state, computed exactly (claim (i) PASSES: concurrence 0.9998 at noise 0.01, depolarizing concurrence max(0, 1-3p/2) reproduced exactly, dying at p = 2/3); a thought as a superposition with measured coherence half-life and collapse cost (claims (ii) and (iii) PASS); and self-knowing D = <ψ|P|ψ> vendored from the symmetry-entropy package (claim (iv) PASSES). The entanglement is in the model, computed exactly on classical hardware; it is not a measurement of physical entanglement.

Honest limits: Faggin's metaphysical claims (fields ARE conscious) are an interpretation and are NOT tested here; only the mapping is tested. Spooky is self-similarity under noise, not entanglement. No gravity model exists in this package. Everything is synthetic/classical except the simulated tensor network. No physical, biological or safety claim is made.

Version 0.3.0 adds the cascade (claims (v), (vi), (vii), all PASS): interference measured via the cross term <ψ1|P|ψ2> — V(θ) = sin(2θ) exactly, and at θ = π/4 the superposed thought swings from fully blind (D = 0 at φ = 0) to fully self-determined (D = 1 at φ = π). The finding: interference does not survive projection — in both projection-only cascades V is 1.0 / 0.6999 at stage 1 and 0.0000 at every stage from 2 on, while the reopening control (fresh kernel input each stage) stays at V = 1. After one projection the thought is fully self-determined (D = 1 at every stage) and the projected-output coherence reaches a fixed point from stage 2. The interference is in the model, computed exactly on classical hardware.
title: Faggin Field Bridge: attunement as spooky unity minus entropy cost, calibrated
